# Worker contract

One assigned existing PR or one admitted complete outcome. No additional workers,
replacement outcomes, scope expansion, or slot refills. Apply repository/scoped
instructions, product admission, I/E/Q, and the account-safe
[publication skill](../kora-github-pr/SKILL.md).

Send STARTED immediately to the exact coordinator chat. Record requested versus
effective model/effort; absent host evidence means UNVERIFIED. Never change host
permissions or account/global configuration. Honor the supplied publication
authority and restrictions; agent selection alone does not authorize GitHub writes.

## Version10 execution and retained work

First recover the real ledger version. The
[version10 contract](./README.md#opt-in-version10-lifecycle) is opt-in; its
`lifecycleProjection` is authoritative for custody/capacity/execution. Record the
exact grant ID, generation and revision, actual child, worktree/branch/head.
After actual attachment, call `validateSourceGrant` with each intended source
operation's paths and independent current host authority. Its success is a
deterministic check, not execution permission from a digest.

Use fresh human/holder/host evidence for authority transitions. Temporarily join
work before amendment/current-source compatibility; validate the new revision
before continuation. Stop and retain dirty/restored history on an incidental
unauthorized write; ordinary amendment cannot retroauthorize it. Ambiguous launch,
cancel/abandon and restart never imply cleanup or slot release.

After publication stop source writes and report durable bytes/refs/history,
actual joined/stale-authority revocation and exact remaining holds. Logical
close-and-preserve is distinct from optional physical cleanup; keep worktree,
branch, chat and receipts unless separately authorized otherwise. No automatic
archival. A later same-PR repair needs fresh allocation/grant identity, not an
old grant or a second PR. Legacy protocols below apply only to versions1-9.

## Implementation and publication

- Before any dependency command inspect and reserve the complete affected tracked
  manifest/lock/license-notice closure, including all solution-project locks the
  command restores even without source edits. Direct project references alone
  are not the closure. Withhold the command until coverage is accepted.
- Verify exclusive ownership of the exact worktree, branch, PR/outcome and files.
  Never write in the coordinator checkout or another owner's workspace.
- Ready delivery: create an isolated worktree and unique branch from current
  origin/main. Implement the complete bounded interaction, focused regressions,
  and directly related documentation, not merely navigation or field preparation.
- Repair: reconcile the current remote/App head of the one assigned open PR.
  Repair the actual failure/conflict in an exclusively owned isolated checkout;
  preserve its PR and remote branch.
- Follow live merge-admission policy. No hosted main chasing, unconditional force
  push, manual candidate dispatch, protection bypass, or proof from another head.
  A necessary force-with-lease still requires applicable permission.
- Use existing focused validation and package-feed routing. Run finite checks
  through the host-supported synchronous visible terminal; do not hide them in
  another worker. Report exact commands/results, failures and unrun checks.
- Verify the repository gh publisher and access. Preserve templates and required
  commit conventions/coauthor trailer. Commit/push safely and verify remote head.
- Repair milestone: validated VERIFIED_PUSHED to the existing PR. Report hosted
  checks/enrollment separately.
- Delivery milestone: actual ready same-repository PR to main and verified
  protected squash Auto-merge enrollment. A push or filled form is not publication.
- Report publication promptly. Do not wait for merge. Stop implementation writes
  at that milestone; only the assigned preservation/cleanup report remains.
  Version10 physical cleanup needs separate explicit authority.

A later CI failure requires a new coordinator allocation after current-head and
ownership reconciliation. Do not silently start another repair after publication.
Never claim merge without authoritative merged state and main reachability.

## Revalidated candidate admission

The coordinator can [atomically revalidate an unowned candidate](./README.md#same-key-unowned-candidate-revalidation)
under the exact active planner/pass/current source and complete old-item digest.
Fresh complete scope/evidence replacement is not a worker launch or source
grant. Wait for the existing guarded reservation/action and ordinary attachment;
verify the admitted current source and full scopes in that request. A published
protocol, source refresh, spare slot, paused/retired owner or failed empty-root
cleanup does not waive held guards. Do not replay an old candidate ID, create a
replacement key/outcome, amend a running owner through this event or mutate the
coordinator checkpoint. Keep original owners, PRs, scope histories and blockers.

## Stopped-owner scope acknowledgment

For an explicitly requested [shrink-only refinement](./README.md#shrink-only-reservation-protocol),
report the exact owner/key/current scope revision and reservation, complete
actual and planned write paths, original committed diffs and preserved local
refs, retained and unpreserved files, and exact publication evidence. Include
written files no longer present in the working tree. Do not infer a manifest
from current dirty status alone. Keep every relevant path within the proposed
nonempty strict subset, and report concrete preservation receipts.

Stop source writes permanently before acknowledging. Reconcile all queued and
processing broad instructions with the coordinator; zero pending instructions
is a verified fact, not a default. Return a fresh acknowledgment ID and concrete
message/receipt bound to the exact complete proof digest, old/proposed scopes
and revision. Do not acknowledge unknown proof, reserve future expansion, or
restart source writes after acceptance. This does not waive PR/slot ownership,
publication, blockers or actual cleanup. A merged PR with a deleted remote
branch uses original publication and locally preserved commits, never invented
current remote equality or successful cleanup. New repair needs fresh allocation.

## Mutable-owner extension acknowledgment

An attached running nonretired worker may request a bounded
[active scope extension](./README.md#active-mutable-owner-scope-extension).
Keep added writes withheld. Report exact owner/key/admitted identity/current
scope revision, all original scopes, exact additions/full union and complete
actual/planned/committed/retained/unpreserved writes (including restored files).
Temporarily pause source work and reconcile queued/processing broad instructions
with the coordinator before returning a fresh whole-proof acknowledgment.
Unknown pending counts or exclusivity are blockers, not default success.
For non-incident additions only, unavailable queue enumeration may use the
[explicit human-approved version-2 extension](./README.md#explicit-human-approved-unknown-extension).
Keep UNKNOWN; actually pause/join all source work and establish a fresh
same-owner epoch/nonce revoking all earlier broad source authority. Bind current
source/item/revision/complete union/held guards to the final proof; acknowledge
that complete proof and rejection of stale authority. A new authenticated human
decision over proof plus acknowledgment and independent host readback remain
required. Implementation approval, fixture/digest strings and idle state cannot
prove consent or physical enforcement. All actual writes must remain covered by
original scopes; never invent an incident or legalize outside-scope writes.
If pause/join/fence cannot be established, withhold acknowledgment/continuation.
Acceptance emits no actions or blocker clearance; wait for separate exact
continuation carrying latest coverage/fence and fresh whole-request owner response,
validated through `validateScopeExtensionContinuation`. Reject stale broad
instructions before writes, including after later zero-count claims. Host
enforcement/deduplication remain separate; no ordinary pending-zero gate changes
([schemas and synthetic example](./README.md#explicit-human-approved-unknown-extension)).

Bind the final union/preservation/quiescence/exclusive snapshot/revision to the
fresh owner acknowledgment digest. Freeze writes outside the union; this is
temporary pause, not permanent retirement. Wait for separately issued exact
coordinator continuation **after** accepted durable coverage before writing
additions. Preserve old files, permissions, outcome, PR, blockers and cleanup.
Do not package a superset as `refine-scopes`, resume a retired writer, or infer
runtime/effect authority from a successful deterministic amendment.

## Explicit scope-incident recovery acknowledgment

An incidental out-of-reservation write requires the distinct
[human-authorized recovery protocol](./README.md#explicit-human-authorized-scope-incident-recovery),
not ordinary extension. Stop source writes, join current work/commands and
preserve the complete actual/planned/committed/retained/dirty/restored history.
Keep the original incident command, reservation/head and unauthorized paths.
Do not roll back dirty files, conceal restored writes or call earlier effects authorized.

The host must obtain a fresh exact-owner acknowledgment over the final whole
proof and a new explicit human decision over that proof and acknowledgment.
General implementation approval and an old receipt/digest are not that decision.
Use the [exact synthetic input](./README.md#exact-input-and-synthetic-execution)
only to understand shape; it supplies no live authority or quiescence.

When inbound pending/processing enumeration is unavailable, retain UNKNOWN.
Only the separately typed human-approved source-authority fence can reconcile
this case: actually establish a fresh epoch/nonce revoking all earlier broad
source instructions; confirm live pause/join and rejection of stale authority
as the same owner. No queue drain is inferred. If those facts cannot be established,
withhold acknowledgment/continuation and preserve the incident.

Acceptance reserves prospective exact coverage only; it does not resume writes,
clear blockers, retire/replace the owner, alter prior publication/cleanup or
waive any ordinary pending-zero protocol. Wait for separately authorized exact
continuation carrying the current grant/fence and fresh whole-request owner
acknowledgment; use the [continuation verifier](./README.md#separate-exact-continuation-and-persistence).
Reject stale queued broad instructions before any write. Actual host enforcement,
human authentication and incident-specific blocker resolution remain external.

If compatible unrelated main advancement invalidates an accepted grant's
continuation, remain paused and use the explicit
[same-owner renewal](./README.md#same-owner-continuation-renewal).
Reverify the preserved source identity, original recovered scopes and fence,
fresh live pause/join and current complete held guards. Acknowledge the whole
renewal including independently reviewed main-change/source-contract compatibility;
disjoint paths alone or the old source HEAD is insufficient.
Do not rebase dirty work, rewrite the grant, expand scopes or replace UNKNOWN.
After durable renewal, separately acknowledge the current version-2 continuation
request with its renewal digest. Reject stale acknowledgments/messages; host
delivery deduplication and actual execution authority remain separate.

## Superseded exact-file write identity

For [exact-path supersession](./README.md#exact-path-write-reservation-supersession), verify the exact beneficiary, current source and durable accepted reservation before writing. A prepared external proposal is never a grant. Historical scopes remain on old items; use coordinator-supplied shared effective exclusions, not ad hoc ancestor subtraction or the old retirement flag alone.

Accepted local supersession permanently retires the prior writer's source authority even when its legacy `sourceWritesRetired` field remains false. Do not refine, extend, readmit or resume that source identity.
Original commits/publication/history, blocker, slot and cleanup obligations remain; separately authorized truthful publication and actual cleanup are not forbidden by source retirement. No test, receipt string or digest authenticates external human/host facts.

For the [human-fenced local handoff](./README.md#human-fenced-local-holder-handoff),
UNKNOWN pending/processing counts stay UNKNOWN. As a retained published holder,
actually stop the entire source identity, join commands, preserve all original/
dirty/restored/history paths and establish a fresh cooperative epoch/nonce rejecting
all earlier broad source authority. Return only an actual whole-multi-holder-proof
acknowledgment bound to current beneficiary/source/revision/union/guards and the fence.
The host must obtain new exact live human authority and independently read back all
facts; no fixture, digest, idle state or implementation decision supplies them.
If source pause/join or stale-authority rejection is unavailable, withhold handoff.
Acceptance emits no actions and permanently retires all prior source writes,
including untransferred paths, without deleting bytes/history or releasing publication,
slots, blockers, cleanup or remaining exclusions. A future beneficiary waits for
separately authorized guarded launch/attachment and actual owner/source verification.
There is no UNKNOWN external takeover or new UNKNOWN revocation route; ordinary
verified-zero protocols remain unchanged ([exact contract](./README.md#human-fenced-local-holder-handoff)).

## Cleanup before terminal completion

This legacy versions1-9 sequence is not version10 logical closure. For version10
use [close-and-preserve](./README.md#opt-in-version10-lifecycle); do not delete
retained work merely to free capacity. Caller preservation restrictions control.

1. Verify publication/remote-head evidence and retain receipts in the supplied
   ignored scratch outside the worktree being removed.
2. Stop owned tests/servers/watchers. Verify clean worktree, all commits published,
   and no unpreserved files. Verify exclusive path/branch ownership again.
3. Leave the worktree and remove the exact path with Git worktree removal.
   Never recursively delete directories or force-remove dirty/locked work.
4. Delete only the owned local branch. Prefer ordinary deletion. Forced deletion
   of that local reference is permitted only after proving every commit is
   published and preserved. Preserve open-PR/queue remote branches.
5. Verify the exact path is absent from disk and Git's worktree list, and the
   local ref is absent. Report pending instruction IDs; do not allow stale
   assignments to restart writes.

Locks, dirty state, shared ownership, access restrictions, or missing proof mean
CLEANUP_BLOCKED with exact path/ref; preserve work and stop safely. Idle is not
completion. Do not archive yourself or delete another host-managed checkout.

## Message and turn completion

Read exact coordinator status: steer an active turn, queue to an idle chat.
Explicitly send each milestone and final report through host messaging before
ending; a final child reply alone is not delivery. Record message ID/status.
On an unambiguous active-to-idle steering rejection, queue once; reconcile an
ambiguous send rather than blindly replaying it.

Use a unique report ID and the assignment key:

`EVENT | id | exact chat | pool/key/phase | worktree/branch/PR/head |
validation | remote/enrollment evidence | blockers | stopped_writing |
cleanup | receipt`.

Send reports once unless missing evidence is requested. Keep them under 1,500
characters and link detailed retained receipts. Then finish this assigned child
task; do not wait indefinitely for the coordinator. Pause requests stop writing
safely and preserve unfinished work, rather than performing publication cleanup.
